description: Endorsement of the Global Charter on Children’s Care Reforms
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-05-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka is a long-standing State Party to the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child and is committed to fulfilling its international obligations to protect and promote the rights of the children. The ‘Global Charter on Children’s Care Reforms’ has been developed as a multilateral initiative grounded in the principles of the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child. The Charter calls upon Governments to take steps to support families and prevent unnecessary separation of children from their families, to prioritize safe and nurturing family-based alternative care when separation occurs, and to progressively reduce the provision of institutional care for children. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs for Sri Lanka to endorse the Global Charter on Children’s Care Reforms, was approved by the Cabinet.
